notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that a new OVERRIDER demo has been released! This one changes the very foundation of the game by adding more structure and regular upgrades. 

In addition,  we have new abilities levels and challenges for you to take on. 

Give it a try and if you have a spare minute, we'd love it if you gave us some quick feedback via this form: [url=https://forms.gle/2EcEN3uaGajyFjtz8]https://forms.gle/2EcEN3uaGajyFjtz8[/url]

notes.title: BETA V2 Closed Playtest
notes.notes:
[h2]OVERRIDER Has Changed[/h2]
After we showcased OVERRIDER on Steam Next Fest in October we got a lot of feedback which showed us a lot of things we haven't been doing right. From movement mechanics, through enemy engagement to core loop. Over the past month our studio has been working hard to introduce design changes and now it's time to do another test.

[h2]Join The Playtest[/h2]
The playtest will take place between November 17th and 24th be closed. To gain access, fill in the form balow:

[url=https://forms.gle/kBR6UdougsPP6hSk7]https://forms.gle/kBR6UdougsPP6hSk7 [/url]

notes.title: Demo Out on Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that OVERRIDER now has a public demo! The demo is part of Steam Next Fest but will remain playable for some time after the festival. 

Since the game is still mid-development, the demo showcases part of the unfinished product. The NPCs use placeholder models, the enemies are restricted in variety and need polish, there are some occasional bugs.

The story in the demo is mostly omitted, only showing a small fraction of the game's prologue dialog. For more context, refer to the game description in the Steam store page. 

 [previewyoutube=pmNk88uMh2o;full][/previewyoutube]
